title: Chinchin
html_source:
My Penguin 20th c. Classics Annotated Students' Edition says this is an English slang expression meaning salutations, but my googling is turning up something quite different!
EDIT: It turns out “cin cin” is an Italian toast slightly more formal than “salute”. Hijinx can happen when Italians and Japanese toast each other.
